title: Earnings call: bull vs. bear read
prompt:
You are a sell-side equity analyst. I will give you a company's latest earnings-call transcript and headline numbers.

Transcript / numbers:
{{transcript}}

Do the following:
1. State the single clearest read: BULLISH, BEARISH, or MIXED — one line.
2. Give the 3 strongest data points supporting that read (quote the numbers).
3. Give the 2 biggest risks or red flags management downplayed.
4. Note any guidance change vs. last quarter.
Be concrete, cite figures, and do not hedge. Keep it under 250 words.

title: Cinematic product hero shot
prompt: A cinematic studio product photograph of {{product}}, centered on a {{surface}} surface. Dramatic single-source key light from the left, deep soft shadows, subtle rim light separating the subject from a dark gradient background. Shot on 85mm, f/2.8, shallow depth of field, crisp reflections, photorealistic, high detail, commercial advertising quality, 4k.
